title: Magnitude and Direction of a Displacement Vector
body: A mouse pointer moves from point $$(6.0\, \text{cm$$,} $$1.6\, \text{cm})$$ to point $$(2.0\, \text{cm$$,} $$4.5\, \text{cm})$$ on a monitor. From Example $$2.3$$, the displacement vector is $$\vec{D$$} $$=$$ $$(-4.0\, \text{cm})\hat{i$$} + $$(2.9\, \text{cm})\hat{j}$$. $$What$$ $$are$$ $$the$$ $$magnitude$$ $$and$$ $$direction$$ $$angle$$ $$of$$ $$this$$ $$displacement$$ $$vector$$?
